predicate_notes.aggregation: expected bucket counts computed directly from the corpus; keyword fields are already lowercase so index normalisation is a no-op.
predicate_notes.combined_filters: intersection of class, project and numeric predicates above.
predicate_notes.numeric_condition: relevant = documents whose effective metric (metrics.<field>, else the first present fallback field) satisfies the operator; approx means value +/- 0.5.
predicate_notes.pagination: relevant = full filtered set; integrity requires no cross-page duplicates and union == full set.
predicate_notes.regression_snapshot: COMPATIBILITY ONLY — records current behaviour (may include known gaps: material filter ignored, classification aggregation broken). Not ground truth; excluded from correctness metrics.
predicate_notes.semantic_vector: relevant = documents whose fixed 40-dim vector has cosine > 0.35 with the fixed query vector (pre-filtered by class where given); computed offline, independent of OpenSearch.
predicate_notes.structured_filter: relevant = documents whose ifc_class is in the query class variant set and (if given) whose project_id matches.
predicate_notes.zero_result: expects_zero: system must return 0 hits and total 0.
